baselines: wallet-history heuristic (no prior payment to the recipient)
calibration: reliability curve and Brier score only with >= 100 reviewed items per class
candidate_population: defined by candidates/2 before any model exists; never by a model score
cutoff: after the candidate's transaction executes, before anything later in its block
eligibility: candidates/2 outputs with complete or partial recorded history; known-positive overlaps never serve as negatives
fairness: every method (rules, heuristics, models) scores the same eligible events
every method sees only information available at the same cutoff
every method is judged against the same label policy and the same split
the production rule is replayed on the same recorded histories, never with more context than the models

label_count_stages.feature_exploration: >= 30 per class from >= 5 campaign groups (activation gate)
label_count_stages.generalization: several time periods and many campaigns; not reachable with the current cohorts
label_count_stages.hyperparameter_selection: a validation split disjoint by campaign and later in time; >= 30 per class in validation itself
label_count_stages.low_fpr_claim: FPR <= 1% needs about 300+ effectively independent negatives with 0 false positives (one-sided 95%)
label_count_stages.performance_estimate: an untouched test split; see ml/power.bound_table for what its negatives can bound
label_count_stages.smoke_test: any labels; software correctness only, never a reported metric

label_provenance.negative: label-policy/1 reviewed_legitimate (two independent humans, confirmed, positive evidence of a legitimate interpretation)
label_provenance.unknown: excluded from the strict benchmark and counted

no_gnn: graph context enters as tabular features; no GNN without a new hypothesis

populations.test: a later, untouched set; the frozen cohorts count only if never used in development (benchmark.Holdout)
populations.train: reviewed items outside both frozen review cohorts
populations.validation: grouped-temporal split of the training population

prediction_unit: victim-event: one candidate transfer to or from one wallet
primary_metric: average precision on test, reported with recall at FPR <= 5%
resource_budget: CPU only, < 2 GB RAM, < 2 minutes per fit (larger needs approval)
split: grouped-temporal/1 with typed-groups/1 entities (victim, lookalike, planting tx, signer, imitated, counterfeit token); public tokens and routers never link
test_set: untouched until the model, features, threshold rule and metrics are frozen
threshold: chosen on validation only: the highest recall with FPR <= 5%
